name: popover
useFor: Use for a small form or detail tied to one control (rename a mailbox, set a phone line's state). Put a PopoverHeader with a PopoverTitle and PopoverDescription first, then the fields. For choosing one value from a list use Select or Combobox; for actions use Dropdown Menu.
constraints: A popover that opens on hover (use Hover Card)
A dark or lilac popover panel
Scaling from the center instead of the trigger
Long forms that scroll inside a popover
source: Extrapolated from the Inkbox console (Figma 427:2715): the raised white panel of the select and the selected tab (Shadow/S), the field and button sizes
title: Popover
description: A raised white panel with 16px corners and the floating shadow that grows out of the control that opened it.
